files.summary: XAML for Liked Songs recents card. Outer transparent Grid allows Composition fan visuals to overflow bounds. CardChrome Border provides rounded background/border without clipping children. ContentRoot has ImageArea (ThumbnailHost + HeartTile with purple linear gradient) and title/subtitle text row with checkmark glyph.

Renders fanned album thumbnail SpriteVisuals via WinUI Composition (avoids pixel shimmer; enables per-sprite DropShadow). Implements INavCacheSurfaceParticipant to release/restore LoadedImageSurfaces off-screen. Fan layout ratios proportional to host width (ThumbSizeRatio=0.60, HeartSizeRatio=0.40). Hover animates fan spread and heart tile translate+scale via compositor animations (280ms). Two tile variants: Liked Songs (purple heart) vs Your Episodes (green headphones), switched via NavigationUri DP.
Wraps a single AnimatedVisualPlayer (AutoPlay=False, IsHitTestVisible=False) for the Lottie equalizer animation.

CPU-optimized Lottie now-playing equalizer. Pauses when IsActive=false or scrolled out of viewport (EffectiveViewportChanged, 4px threshold). DPs: IsActive, IconSize, EqualizerColor. Color resolves from AccentFillColorDefaultBrush fallback chain. Uses LightRedEqualizer generated source.
Generic media card: square CompositionImage with CornerRadius=8, placeholder FontIcon, title and subtitle TextBlocks inside a drag-root Grid wrapping a Button.

General-purpose media card for albums, playlists, artists, shows. DPs: ContextUri, ContextKind, ImageUrl, Title, Subtitle, CardSize, PlaceholderGlyph. Drag source via ManualDragAttachment (AlbumDragPayload, PlaylistDragPayload, ArtistDragPayload). CardClick and CardRightTapped events.
V4A Tour and Merch tile. 180x180 Border with ImageBrush background (intrinsically rounded), acrylic price chip overlay, title, subtitle, Buy HyperlinkButton.
Merch card: ImageUrl loads BitmapImage (DecodePixelWidth=360), Price/Title/Subtitle DPs. Price chip and subtitle collapse when empty. Unloaded nulls ImageSource. CardClick/BuyClick events.
XAML skeleton for animated border-beam: BaseBorder pulsing outline plus Canvas with four beam Borders. Starts Collapsed.

Animated border-beam loading indicator. Four gradient beams travel around the perimeter via XAML Storyboard with TranslateX/Y and Opacity keyframe animations. BaseBorder pulses opacity. DPs: BeamThickness, BeamLength, CornerRadius. Public Start()/Stop() API. Rebuilds on SizeChanged and theme change. Beam color from AccentFillColorDefaultBrush.
V4A Popular Releases row: RootBorder wrapping a Button with 3-column Grid: 64x64 CompositionImage cover, StackPanel with optional PopularNow accent chip plus title and meta, rank TextBlock.

Popular release row. DPs: CoverImageUrl, Title, Meta, Rank, IsFeatured (blue-tinted RootBorder + PopularNow chip), NavigationUri, NavigationTotalTracks, Subtitle. Self-routes via AlbumNavigationHelper with connected animation. Viewport-gated prefetch for album/playlist URIs (500 DIP trigger). CardClick event.
Win2D CanvasControl (UseSharedDevice=True, ClearColor=Transparent, non-hit-testable) for the preview audio visualizer.

Win2D audio waveform visualizer for ContentCard hover. Splits 24-bar spectrum into BassBody (bands 0-7), VocalPresence (bands 7-18 with relative-energy suppression), AirDetail (bands 18-23 with transient emphasis). Each signal drives a multi-harmonic sine wave with Catmull-Rom envelope rendered as layered Win2D DrawLine calls. Subscribes CompositionTarget.Rendering only when active and visible. Pending mode shows idle wave. DPs: BarColor, TrackColor.
Compact 56px horizontal pill: 56x54 CompositionImage left, title TextBlock plus lazy LottieEqualizer plus lazy accent Play button right, lazy PendingBorderBeam overlay.

ShortsPill tracks playback state via NowPlayingChangedMessage and IPlaybackStateService. Hover reveals Play/Pause button; active context shows LottieEqualizer. Play button calls IPlaybackService with 8-second pending timeout and PendingBorderBeam. Middle-click opens new tab. Right-tap shows CardContextMenuBuilder. Dispatches navigation for artist/album/playlist/liked-songs. Liked Songs URI renders heart+purple-gradient placeholder.

Hero-rail spotlight card: acrylic+flyout-stroke Border, mode-exclusive header affordance (PulseDot Ellipse, PinGlyph, or StarGlyph), 72x72 CompositionImage, eyebrow/title/subtitle/CommentBlock with 3px left-bar quote, Play/Save/Share buttons.

V4A artist hero spotlight card. SpotlightMode: LatestRelease (Composition scale+opacity pulse, Save/Share visible), PopularRelease (star glyph, Save/Share), Pinned (pin glyph, comment block, no Save/Share). AccentBrush tints PulseDot, PlayButton, CommentBlock border. Self-routes via AlbumNavigationHelper with connected animation. Viewport-gated album/playlist prefetch.
V4A artist About stat tile: CornerRadius=12 acrylic Border, large bold accent NumberText, CaptionTextBlockStyle LabelText.
Profile fact tile (monthly listeners etc). DPs: Number, Label, AccentBrush (compat only, no longer applied). Used in 2-column UniformGridLayout.
Concert row for V4A Upcoming Concerts: date block with 3px accent stripe and month/day text, venue+city StackPanel with optional NearYou chip, View+Buy HyperlinkButton stack.
Concert row code-behind. DPs: Month, Day, Venue, City, IsNearUser (NearYouChip visibility). CardClick/BuyClick/ViewClick events.

ContentControl subclass (WinUI 3 Border is sealed) exposing ProtectedCursor via ShowHandCursor() and ClearCursor(), enabling hover hand-cursor on click-to-act rows from outside the element class hierarchy.
Static helper showing Save Tabs/Discard Tabs/Cancel ContentDialog for app close with an Always Ask ToggleSwitch. Returns CloseTabsDialogResult (CloseTabsDialogChoice enum + AlwaysAsk bool).
Comment composer: multi-line DraftBox TextBox, CharCountText caption, SubmitButton, InfoBar status, InlineStatusText. Entry point of the Comments control subtree.
